business_problem: Marketing teams must adapt quickly to changing customer behavior while driving efficiency and performance. Siloed, legacy martech systems can limit speed, precision and scalability.
solution_summary: Lastpass built its Databricks implementation around Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Sharing. Marketing teams must adapt quickly to changing customer behavior while driving efficiency and performance. Siloed, legacy martech systems can limit speed, precision and scalability. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Delta Sharing shares governed datasets with external partners and downstream consumers. Reported outcomes include 66% Reduction in paid social purchase cost per acquisition; 50% Reduction in trial cost per acquisition; Reduction in CAC and faster abandoned cart activation in 30 days.
